newsitem.title: DENMARK: Lauritzen sells two refrigeration vessels.
newsitem.headline: Lauritzen sells two refrigeration vessels.

text.p: Danish shipping and shipbuilding group J. Lauritzen A/S said on Wednesday its Lauritzen Reefers unit sold two refrigeration vessels for what it termed a "significant" amount.
It said the two vessels - Belgian Reefer and Brazilian Reefer - built in 1983 and 1984 respectively had approximately 690,000 cubic foot capacity.
Lauritzen said both vessels had been sold to Cayman Island-based Ugland International Holding Plc, with which it already cooperated on chartering vessels.
"The sale is in accordance with group strategy to sell older vessels during the current upswing period on the refrigeratioon ship market," Lauritzen said in a statement.
"Prices for used refrigeration vessels are good and the sale brings in a significant sum for Lauritzen Reefers," it said.
Lauritzen said that it would charter the two vessels back from Ugland and that both parties had agreed not to disclose financial details of the deal.
